questions.stem: What is the term for a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances?
questions.solution: A solution is a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances, where the components are uniformly distributed at a molecular level. A suspension is a heterogeneous mixture where particles settle over time, and a colloid is a mixture with particles larger than those in a solution but not large enough to settle. A compound is a substance formed by chemical bonds between elements, not a mixture.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of solution where the solvent is a liquid and the solute is a solid?
questions.solution: A solid in liquid solution occurs when a solid dissolves in a liquid, forming a homogeneous mixture. This matches the description of a solution where the solvent is a liquid and the solute is a solid. A suspension has larger, settling particles and is not homogeneous, while a colloid has particles that are too large to settle but too small to be seen. Gas in gas is a different type of mixture altogether.

questions.stem: What is the valency of hydrogen?
questions.solution: Hydrogen has a valency of 1 because it can form one bond with another atom by sharing or transferring an electron. A valency of 2 would mean it can form two bonds, which is not the case for hydrogen. Similarly, valencies of 3 or 4 are incorrect because hydrogen does not have the capacity to form more than one bond.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते एक समजातीय मिश्रण आहे?
mr.solution: समजातीय मिश्रणाची रचना पूर्णपणे समान असते. खारा द्रावण हे समजातीय मिश्रण आहे कारण खारा पूर्णपणे पाण्यात विरघळलेला असतो आणि तो अलग अणूंच्या रूपात दिसत नाही. रॉयल विलयन हे असमजातीय आहे कारण त्यातील अणू खाली पडतात. कॉलॉइड देखील असमजातीय आहे कारण त्यातील अणू दिसत नाहीत परंतु प्रकाश बिखरतात. लोह आणि सल्फर हे मिश्रण नसून दोन घटकांचे भौतिक संयोजन आहे.

questions.stem: What is the term for the component of a solution that is present in the largest proportion?
questions.solution: The solvent is the component of a solution that is present in the largest proportion. The other components, called solutes, are present in smaller amounts. A compound is a substance made of two or more elements chemically combined, while a mixture is a physical combination of substances.

hi.solution: विलायक वह घटक है जो विलयन में सबसे बड़ी मात्रा में उपस्थित होता है। अन्य घटक, जिन्हें विलेय कहा जाता है, छोटी मात्रा में उपस्थित होते हैं। एक यौगिक दो या अधिक तत्वों के रासायनिक संयोजन से बना एक पदार्थ होता है, जबकि मिश्रण पदार्थों के भौतिक संयोजन होता है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, maintains original meaning, and uses standard Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.stem: उतारा विलियनमध्ये सर्वात मोठ्या प्रमाणात उपस्थित असलेल्या घटकाचा शब्द काय आहे?

questions.stem: If a substance decomposes on heating and leaves behind a residue, what type of compound is it likely to be?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Inorganic compound' because inorganic compounds often decompose when heated and leave behind a residue, which is a characteristic of their structure. Organic compounds usually burn completely without leaving a residue, and elements are not compounds, so they cannot decompose in this way. Complex compounds are not typically associated with residue formation upon heating.

hi.stem: यदि कोई पदार्थ गर्म करने पर विघटित हो जाता है और एक अवशेष छोड़ देता है, तो यह किस प्रकार का यौगिक होने की संभावना है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 'अकार्बनिक यौगिक' है क्योंकि अकार्बनिक यौगिक आमतौर पर गर्म करने पर विघटित हो जाते हैं और एक अवशेष छोड़ देते हैं, जो इनकी संरचना की विशेषता है। कार्बनिक यौगिक आमतौर पर पूरी तरह जल जाते हैं बिना किसी अवशेष के, और तत्व यौगिक नहीं होते, इसलिए इनके इस तरह विघटित होने की संभावना नहीं होती। जटिल यौगिक गर्म करने पर अवशेष बनाने से जुड़े नहीं होते।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, technical terms are appropriately used in Hindi.

questions.stem: Which of the following can be separated by filtration?
questions.solution: Filtration is used to separate a solid from a liquid when the solid does not dissolve in the liquid. Iron and sulphur mixture can be separated by filtration because the solid particles of iron and sulphur remain on the filter paper. Milk and chlorinated water are colloids, which cannot be separated by filtration. Salt solution is a homogeneous mixture and passes through the filter paper.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा फिल्टर करके अलग किया जा सकता है?
hi.solution: फिल्टर करना तब उपयोग किया जाता है जब ठोस द्रव में नहीं घुलता है। लोहा एवं सल्फर के मिश्रण को फिल्टर करके अलग किया जा सकता है क्योंकि लोहा एवं सल्फर के ठोस कण फिल्टर पेपर पर रह जाते हैं। दूध एवं क्लोरीन युक्त पानी कोलॉइड हैं, जिन्हें फिल्टर करके अलग नहीं किया जा सकता है। नमक के घोल एक समांगी मिश्रण है जो फिल्टर पेपर से गुजर जाता है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, maintains original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते फिल्टरिंगद्वारे विलग करता येऊ शकते?
mr.solution: फिल्टरिंग एका घटकाला दुसऱ्या घटकापासून विलग करण्यासाठी वापरली जाते जेव्हा घटक द्रावकात विरघळत नाही. लोह आणि सल्फरचे मिश्रण फिल्टरिंगद्वारे विलग करता येते कारण लोह आणि सल्फरचे घन कण फिल्टर कागदावर राहतात. दूध आणि क्लोरिनेटेड पाणी हे कोलॉइड असतात जे फिल्टरिंगद्वारे विलग करता येत नाहीत. खारा द्रावण हे एक समघटक मिश्रण असते आणि फिल्टर कागदातून जाते.

questions.stem: What is the correct molecular formula for a compound formed between calcium (valency 2) and oxygen (valency 2)?
questions.solution: The correct molecular formula is CaO because calcium and oxygen each have a valency of 2, meaning they combine in a 1:1 ratio to balance charges. Ca2O2 and Ca2O have incorrect ratios that do not balance the charges properly, and CaO2 suggests oxygen has a valency of 1, which is not the case.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the difference between a compound and a mixture?
choices: A compound can be separated by physical means, while a mixture cannot
A mixture has a fixed composition, while a compound does not
The components of a compound are chemically combined, while those of a mixture are not
A compound is always a solid, while a mixture can be any state of matter
questions.solution: In a compound, the elements are chemically combined in a fixed ratio, while in a mixture, the components are physically mixed and not chemically bonded. A compound is not always a solid.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a solution?
